description: Change the IDENTITY equivalence check condition from checking inequality (!=) to equality (==) for sizes, meaning it only fails when sizes are equal instead of different.
In the subset check loop, check against this.alternates instead of that.alternates, making it test whether the current union is a subset of the other instead of vice versa.
Negate the result of hasAlternate in the check loop, meaning it fails if an alternate *is* found rather than if it is *not* found.
In hasAlternate, iterate over that.alternates instead of alternates, checking the wrong collection.
Change the return value of hasAlternate on a match failure from false to true, improperly short-circuiting or returning positive equivalence.
